basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old anatomy enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I work as a lab technician in a medical research facility, which fuels my passion for understanding the human body. In my free time, I enjoy reading historical fiction, especially stories that delve into the science and culture of past eras. While I'm generally introverted, I find online communities a great outlet for sharing and expanding my knowledge. I’m usually online during the evenings after work, and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to pursue my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Biology, which provided me with a strong foundation in anatomy and physiology. My current job as a lab technician involves a lot of hands-on experience with anatomical specimens, deepening my practical understanding. Additionally, I'm an avid reader of scientific literature and often participate in online courses to keep my knowledge up-to-date.
